channel.title: AC — New media deadlines
channel.description: Reviewed opportunities for creative coding, digital art, experimental sound and new media.

item.title: Interplay 2027
item.description:
A 15–45 minute live online performance at the intersection of performance and technology.
Deadline: 2026-10-08. 23:59 Pacific Artist fee per selected artist or group. Application fee not stated
Eligibility: International, all disciplines and career stages. Priority for projects led by women, femmes and gender-diverse artists.
Selected artists provide a technical breakdown, a five-minute highlight edit and development-process documentation. Live performance must be central to the work.
Official call: https://interplay-arts.com/open_call.html Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Djerassi Artist Residencies
item.description:
One month of studio time in the Santa Cruz Mountains for composers, media artists and other disciplines.
Deadline: 2026-10-09. Cutoff time not confirmed Residency provided at no cost. Cash stipend not confirmed; travel is self-funded. $35 application fee · reconfirm in form
Eligibility: National and international artists. Apply in one discipline; attendance for the full residency is required.
No shortened or partial residencies. Collaborators and couples must apply individually. Full form requirements, including references, have not been verified.
Official call: https://djerassi.org/apply/application-guidelines/ Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: smallforms — Solo Sets
item.description:
Solo experimental music and sound performances, with an optional recording session for a digital release.
Deadline: 2026-10-11. Cutoff time not stated Confirmed artist fee. Travel and accommodation support not stated. Application fee not stated
Eligibility: Musicians, sound artists and performers. One artist per proposal; no geographic restriction stated.
In-person solo performance. Recording-session releases use the smallforms label; confirm release terms if selected.
Official call: https://smallforms.org/open-call-2027/ Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Eyebeam — AGENCY
item.description:
A virtual residency for early-stage work exploring agency through art and technology.
Deadline: 2026-10-11. 23:59 Eastern Stipend, mentorship, technical consultation and weekly residency programming. Free to apply
Eligibility: Individuals based in the US outside NYC, remaining US-based throughout. No full-time degree enrollment or overlapping residency commitments.
Weekly cohort participation and independent project work. The live application specifies 3–4 cohort hours weekly plus independent work; confirm the schedule before accepting.
Official call: https://eyebeam.org/articles/agency-virtual-residency Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Music for Your Inbox
item.description:
Unpremiered experimental sound and music films for an online series and library screenings.
Deadline: 2026-10-15. 23:59 PST as published; daylight-saving ambiguity — submit early Honorarium. Limited production support is available for co-produced films. Application fee not stated
Eligibility: Artists and artist teams; no geographic restriction stated. Music or sound must be central. Films must be 10–20 minutes and not previously premiered.
One year of exclusive presentation rights. Ordinary concert documentation is excluded. In-person attendance is not required. The organizer discourages creating a new project solely for this call.
Official call: https://www.musicforyourinbox.com/apply Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Lendhauer — Urban Ecologies
item.description:
Public artworks exploring coexistence, control and interdependence at Klagenfurt’s Lendhafen.
Deadline: 2026-11-02. Cutoff time not stated Up to €2,500 gross artist fee, €4,000 gross production and €1,000 travel, per selected project. Application fee not stated
Eligibility: Individuals and collectives in Austria and abroad, including artists, designers, performers and interdisciplinary practitioners.
The proposal must engage with the actual harbor and its social, ecological and material conditions. Timing is agreed with selected artists. Fee is per project, not per collaborator.
Official call: https://www.lendhafen.at/open-call-2027-urban-ecologies-coexistence-and-control/ Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: SPOT FLUX — Sound Art
item.description:
Existing sound works, music films and performances for SPOT Festival’s experimental program.
Deadline: 2026-11-05. 14:00 as published; time zone not explicitly stated Danish Musicians’ Union rate per performer, with approved technical and material costs. Exact fee not stated. Application fee not stated
Eligibility: The work and/or artists must have a connection to Denmark. Existing works only; the artist must attend the presentation.
Travel, accommodation and preparation expenses are not covered. The Café Stage is an open, busy space; quiet cannot be guaranteed.
Official call: https://spotfestival.dk/spot-flux-2027-open-call/ Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Amsterdam Light Festival
item.description:
Light artworks for the canals of Amsterdam, with technical and financial support to realize selected concepts.
Deadline: 2026-12-07. 23:59 CET Artist fee plus production and travel costs. General-call production ceiling is not specified in the FAQ. Application fee not confirmed
Eligibility: The general open call is worldwide, including people new to light art. The separate Amarte call is restricted to Netherlands-based makers.
Work must withstand two months outdoors and avoid nuisance to residents, including sound, smoke and lasers. Full briefing and contract terms need review.
Official call: https://amsterdamlightfestival.com/en/open-call Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: OPENFEED
item.description:
A virtual residency spanning interactive installations, software art, sound, electronics and participatory work.
Deadline: 2027-02-28. Rolling review within the October 1–February 28 application window Hardware, computing, software and mentorship. Cash support and exact program dates are not confirmed. Free to apply · form checked Oct 5
Eligibility: International artists working across digital, electronic and experimental media. Individual and participatory practices welcome.
Development may combine an online edition with an on-site presentation. Confirm resources, dates and any attendance requirements before accepting.
Official call: https://www.feed.art/open-feed Checked 2026-10-06

item.title: Sequoia Open Source Fellowship
item.description:
Living-expense support for developers sustaining important open-source projects.
Deadline: Rolling Six to twelve months of support, equity-free. Amount is individualized rather than a published fixed award. Free to apply · form checked Oct 5
Eligibility: Open-source developers; no geographic restriction stated in the reviewed application. A small cohort is selected each year.
No equity or required travel. Confirm the support amount and work expectations with the organizer.
Official call: https://sequoiacap.com/oss Checked 2026-10-05
